subject: Business Studies

internalBreakdown.component: Project: content, observation and research work

notes: The document gives marks for groups of units; each group is recorded as one unit carrying the group's marks.
Project options: field visit, case study on a product, aids to trade, import/export procedure, visit to a state emporium.

units.name: Nature and Purpose of Business; Forms of Business Organisations

chapters.name: Evolution and Fundamentals of Business
topics: History of trade and commerce in India: indigenous banking, rise of intermediaries, transport, trading communities, merchant corporations, major trade centres, imports and exports, position of the Indian sub-continent in the world economy
Business: meaning and characteristics
Business, profession and employment: concept
Objectives of business
Classification of business activities: industry and commerce
Industry: primary, secondary, tertiary
Commerce: trade (internal, external; wholesale and retail) and auxiliaries to trade (banking, insurance, transportation, warehousing, communication, advertising)
Business risk: concept
outcomes: Describe the history of trade and commerce in India
Distinguish economic and non-economic activities and state the characteristics of business
Differentiate between business, profession and employment
Appreciate the economic and social objectives of business and the role of profit
Describe types of industries and the role of commerce, trade and auxiliaries to trade
Examine the nature and causes of business risk

chapters.name: Forms of Business Organisation
topics: Sole proprietorship: concept, merits and limitations
Partnership: concept, types, merits and limitations, registration, partnership deed, types of partners
Hindu Undivided Family business: concept
Cooperative societies: concept, merits, limitations; consumers', producers', marketing, farmers', credit and housing cooperatives
Company: concept, merits and limitations; private, public and one person company
Formation of a company: stages and important documents
Choice of form of business organisation
outcomes: Explain the concept, merits and limitations of each form of business organisation
Discuss types of partners: active, sleeping, secret, nominal and partner by estoppel
Distinguish between a private and a public company
Describe the stages and documents in the formation of a company
Explain the factors that influence the choice of form of organisation

units.name: Public, Private and Global Enterprises; Business Services

chapters.name: Public, Private and Global Enterprises
topics: Public sector and private sector enterprises: concept
Forms of public sector enterprises: departmental undertakings, statutory corporations, government company
Global enterprises: features; joint venture; public private partnership: concept
outcomes: Explain the features, merits and limitations of forms of public sector enterprise
Describe global enterprises, joint ventures and public private partnership

chapters.name: Business Services
topics: Business services: meaning and types
Banking: savings, current, recurring, fixed deposit and multiple option deposit accounts
Banking services: bank draft, bank overdraft, cash credit; e-banking: meaning, types of digital payments
Insurance: principles (utmost good faith, insurable interest, indemnity, contribution, subrogation, causa proxima); life, health, fire and marine insurance
Postal service: mail, registered post, parcel, speed post, courier
outcomes: Describe types of bank account and banking services
Explain the principles and types of insurance
Understand the utility of postal and telecom services

units.name: Emerging Modes of Business; Social Responsibility of Business and Business Ethics

chapters.name: Emerging Modes of Business
topics: E-business: concept, scope and benefits
outcomes: Give the meaning and scope of e-business
Distinguish e-business from traditional business

chapters.name: Social Responsibility of Business and Business Ethics
topics: Concept of social responsibility and the case for it
Responsibility towards owners, investors, consumers, employees, government and community
Role of business in environment protection
Business ethics: concept and elements
outcomes: State the concept of and case for social responsibility
Identify social responsibility towards different interest groups
Describe the elements of business ethics

units.name: Sources of Business Finance; Small Business

chapters.name: Sources of Business Finance
topics: Concept of business finance
Owners' funds: equity shares, preference shares, retained earnings
Borrowed funds: debentures and bonds, loans from financial institutions and commercial banks, public deposits, trade credit, inter corporate deposits
outcomes: State the meaning, nature and importance of business finance
Classify sources of funds and distinguish owners' funds from borrowed funds

chapters.name: Small Business and Enterprises
topics: Entrepreneurship development: concept, characteristics and need; process; Start-up India scheme; ways to fund a start-up
Intellectual property rights and entrepreneurship
Small scale enterprise as defined by the MSMED Act 2006
Role of small business in India, especially in rural areas
Government schemes and agencies: NSIC and DIC, with reference to rural and backward areas
outcomes: Understand entrepreneurship development and intellectual property rights
Discuss the role of small business in India
Appreciate government schemes and agencies for small scale industries

chapters.name: Internal Trade
topics: Internal trade: meaning and types; services of wholesalers and retailers
Retail trade: itinerant and small scale fixed shop retailers
Large scale retailers: departmental stores, chain stores
GST: concept and key features
outcomes: State the types of internal trade and the services of wholesalers and retailers
Explain the types of retail trade and the features of departmental and chain stores
Understand the concept of GST

chapters.name: International Business
topics: International trade: concept and benefits
Export trade: meaning and procedure
Import trade: meaning and procedure
Documents: indent, letter of credit, shipping order, shipping bills, mate's receipt (DA/DP)
World Trade Organization: meaning and objectives
outcomes: Explain the steps in executing export and import trade
Identify and explain the documents used in international trade
Discuss the objectives of the WTO
